title: Der Tag, an dem die Sonne erlosch
original_title: Der Tag, an dem die Sonne erlosch
overview: The sun motif in the art of various peoples (including the Egyptians and the Incas) and the sun’s role as the Earth’s source of energy are explored. The film also features footage of the total solar eclipse on June 30, 1954, on the Swedish island of Galtol.
